submarket: HIDDEN MARKET — "How do I function normally again after a C-section while caring for a newborn?"

finding.headline: "I Can't Sleep in Any Position"
finding.problem: "I haven't slept lying down in 10 days. I'm propped like a corpse and still in pain. Everyone says 'sleep when the baby sleeps' — I physically can't get comfortable."
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "How do I function normally again after a C-section while caring for a newborn?"
finding.person: A 31-yr-old diaspora mom (Leeds) who can't lie on stomach, side hurts her drain-site, back aches; husband snores; baby wakes every 2h — surgical pain + sleep loss collide.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Module (recovery-sleep positions) in A1 / H products.". Verdict: PASSES (4/5).
